column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: the test runs one subtest per dialect and each takes a scratch database from newMySQLScratchDB / newMSSQLScratchDB, which skip when that DSN is unset. This job supplies PostgreSQL only, so mysql and mssql skip and postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set: go test ./migration/ -run TestCreatedAtIsBackfilledFromUpdatedAtNotFromTheMigrationsClock -count=1 -json reports exactly /mysql and /mssql. Only test-go/support carries a line because ./migration/ is in that package group and the cluster job does not run it -- checked against ci.yml rather than assumed from the engine case, where two keys move together. Guards cleat#1702: created_at is BACKFILLED FROM updated_at, not stamped with the migration clock, and the three dialects write that backfill as three separate statements -- with SQL Server additionally having to disable two security policies around it, since its filter predicates exempt nobody. A postgres-only run cannot vouch for the other two.
